question: Which of the following is NOT a main site of transpiration?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Intracellular spaces**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Intracellular spaces** are not a main site of transpiration.
 
• Transpiration primarily occurs through the **stomata**, which are small openings on the surface of leaves that allow for gas exchange.
